notes.title: Patch note 2.0.2.00
notes.notes:
Patch note 2.0.2.00

Chinese (Simplified) is now supported.
Ninja JaJaMaru: The Great Yokai Battle + Hell is now available in simplified Chinese!
Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch note 2.0.1.06
notes.notes:
Patch note 2.0.1.06
Partial translation of English text has been corrected.
Countermeasures against illegal ranking have been taken.

notes.title: Patch note 2.0.1.05
notes.notes:
Patch note 2.0.1.05

 - The contents of Patch note 2.0.1.04 are also included.
 - Changed the image of the button for the operation explanation of the museum to the xbox controller. (Sorry, other controllers are not supported.)
 - Fixed a bug that the screen collapses while posing.
 - Fast-forwarding of the result is now 40x faster than 8x only when JaleCoin is maxed.
 - Language selection is now easier to find. (This is a somewhat aggressive solution, but...)
 - Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Patch note 2.0.1.03
notes.notes:
Patch note 2.0.1.03
 - Fixed a bug that caused freezing in some environments
